About Hyperkey Interactive

Hyperkey Interactive is a game and real-time 3D development company delivering interactive digital products, focused on turning spaces, products and ideas into experiences people can step inside.

Our VR work spans virtual showrooms, apartment walkthroughs, space-design tools, a multiplayer metaverse and virtual-world prototypes built as proofs of concept and MVPs for client demos.

What we deliver

VR Showrooms

Walk-in virtual spaces for presenting products and properties without a physical site.

Real Estate Walkthroughs

Apartment and property demos that let buyers explore layouts at human scale.

Virtual Worlds & Metaverse

Multiplayer worlds with voice chat, meeting rooms and invites, streamed to any device via pixel streaming.

POCs & MVPs

Rapid prototypes and proofs of concept that validate an idea before full production.

Mobile AR Apps

Camera-based AR for placing products and furniture in a real room, from catalogue to purchase.
